description: Anand Sahib - Song of Bliss by Guru Amar Das Ji

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: anand bhaeiaa maeree maae satiguroo mai paaeiaa
verses.translation_en: I am in bliss, O my mother, for I have found my True Guru.
verses.phonetic_key: anand bhaeaa maeree maae satiguroo mai paaeiaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: satiguroo t paaeiaa sehaj saetee man vajeeaa vaadhhaaeeaa
verses.translation_en: I have found the True Guru with ease, and my mind resounds with joyful celebration.
verses.phonetic_key: satiguroo t paaeiaa sehaj saetee man vajeeaa vaadhhaaeeaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਪਰੀਆ ਸਬਦ ਗਾਵਣ ਆਈਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: raag ratan paravaar pareeaa sabad gaavan aaeeaa
verses.translation_en: The jewelled melodies and celestial harmonies have come to sing the Word of the Shabad.
verses.phonetic_key: raag ratan paravaar pareeaa sabad gaavan aaeeaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੋ ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: sabadho t gaavahu haree kaeraa man jinee vasaaeiaa
verses.translation_en: Sing the Shabad of the Lord; those who have enshrined it in their minds.
verses.phonetic_key: sabadho t gaavahu haree kaeraa man jinee vasaaeiaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.transliteration: kehai naanak anand hoaa satiguroo mai paaeiaa
verses.translation_en: Says Nanak, I am in bliss, for I have found my True Guru. ||1||
verses.phonetic_key: kehai naanak anand hoaa satiguroo mai paaeiaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.transliteration: ae man maeriaa too sadhaa rahu har naale
verses.translation_en: O my mind, remain always with the Lord.
verses.phonetic_key: ae man maeriaa too sadhaa rahu har naale

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਹੁ ਤੂ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਾ ॥
verses.transliteration: har naal rahu too mann maere dhookh sabh visaaranaa
verses.translation_en: Remain with the Lord, O my mind, and all sorrows shall be forgotten.
verses.phonetic_key: har naal rahu too mann maere dhookh sabh visaaranaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਾ ॥
verses.transliteration: angeekaar ouhu karae taeraa kaaraj sabh savaaranaa
verses.translation_en: He will accept you and resolve all your affairs.
verses.phonetic_key: angeekaar ouhu karae taeraa kaaraj sabh savaaranaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.transliteration: sabhanaa galaa samarath suaamee so kio manahu visaare
verses.translation_en: The Lord is all-powerful — why forget Him from the mind?
verses.phonetic_key: sabhanaa galaa samarath suaamee so kio manahu visaare

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.transliteration: kehai naanak mann maere sadhaa rahu har naale
verses.translation_en: Says Nanak, O my mind, remain always with the Lord. ||2||
verses.phonetic_key: kehai naanak mann maere sadhaa rahu har naale

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
verses.transliteration: saache saahibaa kiaa naahee ghar taerai
verses.translation_en: O True Lord, what is there that is not in Your home?
verses.phonetic_key: saache saahibaa kiaa naahee ghar taerai

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
verses.transliteration: ghar t taerai sabh kichh hai jis dhaehi s paavae
verses.translation_en: Everything is in Your home; one receives only what You give.
verses.phonetic_key: ghar t taerai sabh kichh hai jis dhaehi s paavae

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਏ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadhaa sifat salaah taeree naam man vasaavae
verses.translation_en: Those who sing Your praises forever enshrine Your Name in their minds.
verses.phonetic_key: sadhaa sifat salaah taeree naam man vasaavae

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.transliteration: naam jin kai man vasiaa vaaje sabad ghanere
verses.translation_en: Those whose minds are filled with the Name — many melodies play for them.
verses.phonetic_key: naam jin kai man vasiaa vaaje sabad ghanere

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.transliteration: kehai naanak sache saahib kiaa naahee ghar taerai
verses.translation_en: Says Nanak, O True Lord, what is there that is not in Your home? ||3||
verses.phonetic_key: kehai naanak sache saahib kiaa naahee ghar taerai

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.transliteration: saachaa naam maeraa aadhaaro
verses.translation_en: The True Name is my support.
verses.phonetic_key: saachaa naam maeraa aadhaaro

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: saach naam adhaar maeraa jin bhukhaa sabh gavaaeeaa
verses.translation_en: The True Name is my support; it has satisfied all my hungers.
verses.phonetic_key: saach naam adhaar maeraa jin bhukhaa sabh gavaaeeaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਛਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁਜਾਈਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: kar saanth sukh man aae vasiaa jin ichhaa sabh pujaaeeaa
verses.translation_en: Peace and happiness have come to dwell in my mind; all desires have been fulfilled.
verses.phonetic_key: kar saanth sukh man aae vasiaa jin ichhaa sabh pujaaeeaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadhaa kurabaan keetaa guroo vitahu jis dheeaa eaehi vaddiaaeeaa
verses.translation_en: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has bestowed such glorious greatness.
verses.phonetic_key: sadhaa kurabaan keetaa guroo vitahu jis dheeaa eaehi vaddiaaeeaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.transliteration: kehai naanak sunahu santhahu sabadh dharahu piaaro
verses.translation_en: Says Nanak, listen O Saints, and enshrine love for the Shabad.
verses.phonetic_key: kehai naanak sunahu santhahu sabadh dharahu piaaro

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
verses.transliteration: saachaa naam maeraa aadhaaro
verses.translation_en: The True Name is my support. ||4||
verses.phonetic_key: saachaa naam maeraa aadhaaro

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.transliteration: vaaje panch sabad thith ghar sabhaagai
verses.translation_en: The five sounds of celestial bliss resound in that blessed home.
verses.phonetic_key: vaaje panch sabad thith ghar sabhaagai

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: ghar sabhaagai sabad vaaje kalaa jith ghar dhaareeaa
verses.translation_en: In that blessed home, the Shabad resounds; He infuses His almighty power into it.
verses.phonetic_key: ghar sabhaagai sabad vaaje kalaa jith ghar dhaareeaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: panch dhooth thudhh vas keete kaal kantak maariaa
verses.translation_en: The five enemies are brought under control; death is overcome.
verses.phonetic_key: panch dhooth thudhh vas keete kaal kantak maariaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhur karam paaeiaa thudhh jin ko s naam har kai laage
verses.translation_en: Those blessed by primal destiny are attached to the Lord's Name.
verses.phonetic_key: dhur karam paaeiaa thudhh jin ko s naam har kai laage

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
verses.transliteration: kehai naanak teh sukh hoaa thith ghar anehad vaaje
verses.translation_en: Says Nanak, there is peace there; the unstruck celestial melody resounds. ||5||
verses.phonetic_key: kehai naanak teh sukh hoaa thith ghar anehad vaaje

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: anand anand sabh ko kehai anand guroo the jaaniaa
verses.translation_en: Bliss, bliss — everyone speaks of bliss; bliss is known through the Guru.
verses.phonetic_key: anand anand sabh ko kehai anand guroo the jaaniaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣਿਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: jaaniaa anand sadhaa gur the kripaa kare piaariaa
verses.translation_en: Bliss is forever known through the Guru; when the Beloved bestows His grace.
verses.phonetic_key: jaaniaa anand sadhaa gur the kripaa kare piaariaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: kar kirapaa kilavikh katte giaan anjan saariaa
verses.translation_en: Granting His grace, He cuts away sins; He applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom.
verses.phonetic_key: kar kirapaa kilavikh katte giaan anjan saariaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.transliteration: andharahu jin kaa mohu tuttaa tin kaa sabad sachai savaariaa
verses.translation_en: Those whose attachment is broken from within — the True Lord adorns them with the Shabad.
verses.phonetic_key: andharahu jin kaa mohu tuttaa tin kaa sabad sachai savaariaa

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੪੦॥੧॥
verses.transliteration: kehai naanak eaehu anand hai anand guroo the jaaniaa
verses.translation_en: Says Nanak, this is bliss; bliss is known through the Guru. ||40||1||
verses.phonetic_key: kehai naanak eaehu anand hai anand guroo the jaaniaa
